note: The curator's reading of every retained alphanumeric display frame the compact runtime evidence cites, pinned by the SHA-256 of the frame's raw sixteen-segment values (compact JSON of the row arrays: the upper row alone for a Coil Test step or Single Lamps designator, the upper and lower rows for a Switch Levels hold, the lower row for a Motor Bank Test edge, and each row alone for the C-Side test title and edges). The readings were checked against the decoded runs before pinning; tools/mousin_around_runtime_evidence.py refuses a run whose cited frame carries other segment values or decodes to another reading, and a run that cites a different set of frames, so a substituted or re-recorded frame cannot inherit a reading.
